headline: Europe-wide data center protests escalate to arrests at Microsoft site
summary: Activists across Europe, including more than 100 campaign groups across 15 countries, staged coordinated protests against AI data centers. Protesters stormed a Microsoft datacentre construction site in Amsterdam and clashed with police. Two days later, the protest turned violent and police arrested 150 to 200 people.
